A '''golden apple''' is an [[apple]] coated in gold nuggets. It heals {{Hp|4}} and grants {{EffectLink|Regeneration}} for 30 seconds and {{EffectLink|Absorption}} for 2 minutes.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/crafting/golden_apple.json}}</ref> It is also a secret [[ingredient]] with its own dishes.

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
The pack's recipe uses 8 gold nuggets instead of gold ingots. It is unlocked by picking up a gold nugget.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/advancement/recipe_unlocks/gold_nugget.json}}</ref>

=== Chest loot ===
{{Sources}}

==== Enchanted variant ====
Some chests (ancient cities, bastion treasure, desert pyramids, dungeons, mineshafts, ruined portals and woodland mansions) can instead contain a stronger golden apple, the pack's replacement for the {{MCW|Enchanted Golden Apple|enchanted golden apple}}. It has the same name and heals {{Hp|4}}, but grants Regeneration II for 30 seconds, Absorption IV for 2 minutes, and {{EffectLink|Fire Resistance}} and {{EffectLink|Resistance}} for 5 minutes each.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/loot_table/food/enchanted_golden_apple.json}}</ref> The vanilla enchanted golden apple doesn't generate.

== Usage ==

=== Secret ingredient ===
{{Spoiler}}
Golden apples can be cooked into [[Baked Golden Apple|baked golden apple]]s, which make [[Canned Golden Apples|canned golden apples]] and the [[Gilded Empanada|gilded empanada]]. None of these recipes appear in the recipe book. See [[Secret recipes]].
